newsitem.title: FINLAND: Fiskars says end-97 market outlook good.
newsitem.headline: Fiskars says end-97 market outlook good.

text.p: Finnish durable consumer goods group Fiskars Oy Ab said on Monday the market outlook for the end of 1997 was good.

"The market outlook for the latter part of the year is good," Fiskars said. "Economic growth in the corporation's principal market, the United States, has been stronger than anticipated and is expected to prevail.
"Most of the European markets are expected to show a positive trend in the latter half of 1997," it added.

Fiskars reported first half profit before extraordinary items rising to 219 million markka from 139 million in the year-ago period. This was just above its 218 million markka full-1996 profit before extraordinaries.
It did not give a full-year 1997 profit forecast.
